# jobrunner

Small job runner with a pluggable retry policy.

## Retry policy

`run_job` accepts a `RetryConfig` and an injected `Sleeper`. `max_attempts`
includes the initial call, so a value of `1` disables retries. Only
`RetryError::Transient` failures are retried; `RetryError::Permanent` failures
are returned immediately.

Retries use bounded exponential backoff. The first retry waits
`base_delay_ms`, each subsequent retry doubles the delay, and no delay exceeds
`max_delay_ms`. Delays are recorded by `FakeSleeper` in tests, so callers can
verify the policy without waiting.
